description: This source file defines CLI commands for managing slash commands in Mattermost, including creating, listing, archiving, modifying, moving, and showing commands. It uses Cobra for CLI structure and interacts with Mattermost's API via a client interface.

methods.name: addCommandFieldsFlags
methods.description: Adds CLI flags for command properties such as title, description, trigger word, URL, creator, response username, icon, autocomplete options, and HTTP method.

methods.name: createCommandCmdF
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new slash command by gathering input flags, validating trigger, and calling the API to create the command.

methods.name: listCommandCmdF
methods.description: Lists all commands for specified or all teams, handling pagination and errors.

methods.name: archiveCommandCmdF
methods.description: Archives (deletes) a command by ID and reports success or failure.

methods.name: modifyCommandCmdF
methods.description: Modifies an existing command's properties based on provided flags and updates via API.

methods.name: moveCommandCmdF
methods.description: Moves a command to a different team by ID.

methods.name: showCommandCmdF
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific command.

search-terms: create, list, archive, modify, move, show commands
